output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The burnFrom function allows a contract to claim a large amount of tokens from an arbitrary user, due to incorrect computations, allowing attackers to acquire a large amount of tokens for a very small fee.
The transferFrom function allows a contract to transfer tokens to arbitrary addresses, allowing attackers to transfer tokens to arbitrary addresses, possibly leading to a security vulnerability.
The freezeAccount function allows a contract owner to freeze an arbitrary user's assets, allowing attackers to steal assets due to incorrect access control.
The mintToken function allows a contract owner to mint arbitrary tokens, allowing attackers to increase supply arbitrarily, aka the 'mintToken' attack.
